reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin for observing and directing multiple local Agents, including sending instructions, tracking progress, and exposing orchestration tools through MCP; human review is appropriate because commands can start work that may read or modify files, execute commands, and consume APIs.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 中统一观测多个本机 Agent 的会话与状态，并发送指令、跟踪进度和编排任务。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin for monitoring multiple local Agent sessions, sending instructions, tracking progress, and coordinating tasks.

capabilities: observes local Agent sessions and activity
searches session metadata by title, working directory, or identifier
sends instructions to local Agent sessions
starts or resumes Agent processes through CLI or in-process mechanisms
reports task progress and incremental output
reads compressed local session files for text summaries
exposes orchestration tools through an MCP server
